concept_options.title: What If AI Rented Your Brain While You Slept?
concept_options.why_this_works: The topic title from the 2026-11-12 AI slate (f-ai-rents-your-sleeping-brain, 78/100, 1st of 24); the writer's pick; pairs with thumbnail a (THAT'S ME?)
concept_options.visual_approach: Your bedroom after midnight, mood night, the red curtains behind: you large at the left, asleep on your back on a dark pillow, smiling, a thin band with a teal light across your forehead; a dotted glowing thread rises to a pale second you, bolt upright at a little floating desk, wide awake, typing on a lit laptop; gold coins arc from the desk over your head into the half-full jar on your bedside table; one crimson arrow to the second you. Three candidates a, b, c differ only in the tag (THAT'S ME?, WORTH IT?, EASY CASH?); drawn in code, brand/thumbs/brainrent
concept_options.hook: Dawn in an El Paso clinic chair: the nurse counts three notes into your hand ('Thursday. Not before.'), and a man in a grey suit at the door holds out a thin band: 'Sleep tonight. Get paid.' That night a pale second you sits up out of your head and works while you sleep, and coins fall into the jar.

selected_concept.rationale: Writer's recommendation; the owner picks at G1. Title A with thumbnail a ("THAT'S ME?"): the topic's own title, the AI angle that makes the daydream new, and the tag is what a viewer asks of the ghost before they click.

stages.approach: Packaging (G1, 2026-11-13): three titles, three one-variable thumbnails drawn in code (brand/thumbs/brainrent), the beat outline on the template spine opening on a performed skit; claims.md started at G1 (25 rows); the G1 room (story editor, claims check)

research.md, claims.md, script.md, sequel.md and 6-8 chapters on the template (rules/story.md #1-#19, 155 wpm, 9-10 min); the free local Qwen-Arthur narration and a 720p first cut before G2; the G2 room; omni qc story_script must pass
Picture lock: cut, key shot, text, music and mix; signed with G2 in one cut review; the local voice ships unless the owner asks for the paid A/B
The owner watches at 1x with cold viewers
publish.md and upload.yaml; private upload only when the owner asks

line_items.notes: Free and local. The paid voice only if the owner asks for the A/B, quoted first. G1 made no paid call: the thumbnails are drawn in code; the writer and the room used subscriptions and today's capped room calls
